subject: Hormonal tides reshape the brain: MRE reveals estrogen-driven mechanical plasticity in the hippocampus
script: From Agewell Brief: Hormonal tides reshape the brain: MRE reveals estrogen-driven mechanical plasticity in the hippocampus. New imaging shows estrogen fluctuations alter hippocampal stiffness across the reproductive cycle—a biophysical window into how hormones sculpt neural tissue. The brain is not a static organ. It is a viscoelastic structure—part solid, part fluid—whose mechanical properties shift with physiology. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
